1.text: Muri icyo gihe abantu ibihumbi byinshi bateranira aho ari, ndetse bigeza aho bakandagirana. Nuko abwira abigishwa be ati “Mubanze mwirinde umusemburo w'Abafarisayo ari wo buryarya,

2.text: kuko ari nta cyatwikiriwe kitazatwikururwa, cyangwa icyahishwe kitazamenyekana.

3.text: Nuko ibyo mwavugiye mu mwijima byose bizumvikanira mu mucyo, n'icyo mwongoreraniye mu mazu imbere kizavugirwa hejuru yayo.

4.text: “Kandi ndababwira mwebwe ncuti zanjye nti ‘Ntimugatinye abica umubiri, hanyuma ntibagire ikindi babatwara.

5.text: Ahubwo ndabereka uwo mukwiriye gutinya: mutinye umara kwica umuntu agashobora kumujugunya muri Gehinomu. Ni koko, ndababwira abe ari we mutinya.’

6.text: “Mbese ibishwi bitanu ntibigurwa amakuta abiri? Nyamara nta na kimwe muri byo cyibagirana mu maso y'Imana.

7.text: Ndetse n'umusatsi wo ku mitwe yanyu wose warabazwe. Ntimutinye rero, kuko muruta ibishwi byinshi.

8.text: “Kandi ndababwira yuko uzampamiriza imbere y'abantu, nanjye Umwana w'umuntu nzamuhamiriza imbere y'abamarayika b'Imana,

9.text: ariko unyihakanira imbere y'abantu, na we azihakanirwa imbere y'abamarayika b'Imana.

10.text: “Kandi umuntu wese usebya Umwana w'umuntu azabibabarirwa, ariko utuka Umwuka Wera ntazabibabarirwa.

11.text: “Kandi nibabajyana mu masinagogi no mu batware no mu bakomeye, ntimuzahagarike umutima w'icyo muzireguza cyangwa w'ibyo muzavuga,

12.text: kuko Umwuka Wera azabigisha ibyo muzaba mukwiriye kuvuga muri uwo mwanya.”

13.text: Nuko umuntu umwe wo muri iryo teraniro aramubwira ati “Mwigisha, bwira mwene data tugabane imyandu.”

14.text: Na we aramusubiza ati “Wa mugabo we, ni nde wanshyizeho kuba umucamanza wanyu, cyangwa ngo ngabanye ibyanyu?”

15.text: Arababwira ati “Mwitonde kandi mwirinde kwifuza kose, kuko ubugingo bw'umuntu butava mu bwinshi bw'ibintu bye.”

16.text: Nuko abacira umugani ati “Hariho umukungu wari ufite imirima irumbuka cyane,

17.text: nuko aribaza mu mutima we ati ‘Ndagira nte ko ntafite aho mpunika imyaka yanjye?’

18.text: Aribwira ati ‘Ndabigenza ntya: ndasenya urugarama rwanjye nubake urundi runini, abe ari mo mpunika imyaka yanjye yose n'ibintu byanjye.

19.text: Ni bwo nzabwira umutima wanjye nti: Mutima, ufite ibintu byinshi bibikiwe imyaka myinshi, ngaho ruhuka, urye unywe, unezerwe.’

20.text: Ariko Imana iramubwira iti ‘Wa mupfu we, muri iri joro uranyagwa ubugingo bwawe. Ibyo wabitse bizaba ibya nde?’

21.text: “Ni ko umuntu wirundaniriza ubutunzi amera, atari umutunzi mu by'Imana.”

22.text: Abwira abigishwa be ati “Ni cyo gituma mbabwira nti: Ntimukīganyire ngo mutekereze iby'ubugingo muti ‘Tuzarya iki?’ Cyangwa iby'umubiri muti ‘Tuzambara iki?’

23.text: Kuko ubugingo buruta ibyokurya, n'umubiri uruta imyambaro.

24.text: Mwitegereze ibikona bitabiba ntibisarure, ntibigire ububiko cyangwa ikigega, nyamara Imana irabigaburira. Mwe se ntimuruta ibisiga cyane?

25.text: Ni nde muri mwe wabasha kwiyunguraho umukono umwe, abiheshejwe no kwiganyira?

26.text: Nuko ubwo mutabasha gukora igito rwose, ni iki kibaganyisha ibindi?

27.text: Mwitegereze uburabyo uko bumera: ntibugira umurimo bukora, ntibuboha imyenda, ariko ndababwira yuko Salomo mu bwiza bwe bwose atarimbaga nka kamwe muri bwo.

28.text: Ariko Imana ubwo yambika ubwatsi bwo mu gasozi ityo, buriho none n'ejo bakabujugunya mu muriro, ntizarushaho kubambika mwebwe abafite kwizera guke mwe?

29.text: “Ntimugahagarike umutima wo gushaka ibyokurya n'ibyokunywa, kandi ntimwiganyire.

30.text: Ibyo byose abapagani bo mu isi ni byo bashaka, burya So aba azi ko namwe mubikennye.

31.text: Ahubwo mushake ubwami bwe, kuko ari ho ibyo muzabyongerwa.

32.text: “Mwa mukumbi muto mwe, ntimutinye kuko So yishimira kubaha ubwami.

33.text: Mugure ibyo mufite, mutange ku buntu. Mwidodere udusaho tudasaza, ari bwo butunzi budashira buri mu ijuru, aho umujura atabwegera n'inyenzi ntizibwonone,

34.text: kuko aho ubutunzi bwanyu buri, ari ho n'imitima yanyu izaba.

36.text: mumere nk'abantu bategereza shebuja aho agarukira ava mu bukwe, kugira ngo ubwo azaza nakomanga bamukingurire vuba.

37.text: Hahirwa abagaragu shebuja azaza agasanga bari maso. Ndababwira ukuri yuko azakenyera, akabicaza akabahereza.

38.text: Naza mu gicuku cyangwa mu nkoko agasanga bameze batyo, bazaba bahirwa.

39.text: Kandi mumenye ibi yuko nyir'inzu iyaba yamenyaga igihe umujura azazira, yabaye maso, ntiyakunze ko inzu icukurwa.

40.text: Namwe muhore mwiteguye, kuko Umwana w'umuntu azaza mu gihe mudatekereza.”

41.text: Petero aramubaza ati “Databuja, uwo mugani ni twe twenyine uwuciriye cyangwa ni abantu bose?”

42.text: Umwami Yesu aramusubiza ati “Ni nde gisonga gikiranuka cy'ubwenge, shebuja azasigira abo mu rugo rwe ngo abagerere igerero igihe cyaryo?

43.text: Hahirwa uwo mugaragu shebuja azaza agasanga abikora.

44.text: Ndababwira ukuri yuko azamwegurira ibyo afite byose.

45.text: Ariko uwo mugaragu niyibwira ati ‘Databuja aratinze’, agatangira gukubita abagaragu n'abaja, no kurya no kunywa no gusinda,

46.text: shebuja w'uwo mugaragu azaza umunsi atamutegereje n'igihe atazi, azamucamo kabiri amuhanane n'abakiranirwa.

47.text: “Kandi uwo mugaragu wari uzi ibyo shebuja ashaka, ntiyitegure ngo akore ibyo ashaka, azakubitwa inkoni nyinshi.

48.text: Ariko uwari utabizi agakora ibikwiriye kumuhanisha, azakubitwa nkeya. Uwahawe byinshi wese azabazwa byinshi, n'uweguriwe byinshi ni we bazarushaho kwaka byinshi.

49.text: “Naje kujugunya umuriro mu isi, none niba umaze gufatwa ndacyashaka iki kandi?

50.text: Hariho umubatizo nkwiriye kuzabatizwa. Nyamuna uburyo mbabazwa kugeza aho uzasohorera!

51.text: Mbese mutekereza yuko nazanywe no kuzana amahoro mu isi? Ndababwira yuko atari ko biri, ahubwo naje gutanya abantu!

52.text: Kuko uhereye none hazabaho batanu mu nzu imwe badahuje, abatatu n'ababiri, kandi n'ababiri n'abatatu badahuje.

53.text: Umwana ntazahuza na se, na se n'umwana we ntibazahuza. Umukobwa ntazahuza na nyina, na nyina n'umukobwa we ntibazahuza. Umukazana ntazahuza na nyirabukwe, na nyirabukwe n'umukazana we ntibazahuza.”

54.text: Nuko abwira abateraniye aho na bo ati “Iyo mubonye igicu kivuye iburengerazuba, uwo mwanya muravuga ngo ‘Imvura iragwa’, kandi ni ko biba.

55.text: N'iyo mubonye umuyaga uturutse ikusi, muravuga ngo ‘Haraba ubushyuhe’, kandi ni ko biba.

56.text: Mwa ndyarya mwe, ko muzi kugenzura isi n'ijuru, ni iki kibabuza kugenzura iby'iki gihe?

57.text: “Kandi namwe ubwanyu, ni iki kibabuza guhitamo ibitunganye?

58.text: Nujyana n'ukurega kuburanira ku mutware, ugire umwete mukiri mu nzira wikiranure na we ngo ye kugukururira ku mucamanza, umucamanza akagushyikiriza umusirikare, na we akagushyira mu nzu y'imbohe.

59.text: Ndakubwira yuko utazavamo rwose, keretse umaze kwishyura umwenda wose hadasigaye ikuta na rimwe.”
